channel.title: Angola - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Angola, every source cited.

item.title: African Union and FAJ condemn attacks on journalists
item.description: The African Union and the Federation of African Journalists highlighted evolving threats and persistent impunity for crimes against media professionals.

item.title: Angola rural teen pregnancy rate hits 42.5%
item.description: UN committee urges Angola to fund national strategy for adolescent sexual education and reproductive health services.

item.title: Jonas Savimbi's legacy highlighted by UNITA founder's foundation
item.description: The foundation emphasized Savimbi's commitment to Angolan identity and his role in challenging Portuguese colonial rule.
